title: Fault episode ground truth
description: One row per injected fault. `start`/`end` are the exact virtual-clock bounds of the fault window. A window overlapping [start, end) for a resource listed in `affected` is anomalous; everything else is normal.

episode.description: unique per label row across the dataset -- what the harness keys detection delay on. An `intermittent` episode emits one row per ON burst, so these do not map 1:1 onto scheduled_episode.

scheduled_episode.description: index of the generator's episode loop that produced this row

shape.description: how the fault was driven over time

burst.description: 0 for single-span shapes; the ON-burst index for intermittent

target.description: resource the fault was injected against

affected.description: every resource degraded by this fault, including `target`
